scope: Model-independent evaluation rules established after inspecting earlier results; not a prospective preregistration

temporal_rules.interval_convention: Half-open [start, end); training events must precede start
temporal_rules.earlier_cohort: Development-period evidence only; it includes parameter-selection users
temporal_rules.independence_limit: Later outcomes are temporally disjoint from development but have already been inspected; no fresh independent validation claim
temporal_rules.sampled_development: Validation is used for model selection, calibration, and ranking-weight selection; no within-validation subgroup is called independent confirmation
temporal_rules.component_fit_gate: All learned windows, weights, scalers and calibration must be fit before their evaluation boundary; current MLP checkpoints were selected using validation ending 1582493743 and are permitted only for sampled test queries after that boundary
temporal_rules.full_catalog_bim_gate: Do not reuse current MLP checkpoints in the full-catalog cohort starting 1582401299, or current 1582312306-fitted windows in development starting 1582239167; full-catalog BIM requires a separate earlier-fit pipeline

eligibility_rules.catalog: Only IDs with first observed event strictly before graph training cutoff
eligibility_rules.availability_limit: Observed-item proxy only; actual listing publication and expiry metadata are not established
eligibility_rules.full_catalog: Training users with at least one eligible unseen post-cutoff pair; relevance restricted to the same eligible catalog; report removed relevance and users
eligibility_rules.sampled: Conditional first alternative-job successful contact within 24 hours; complete follow-up before partition end; target unobserved by user at or before query
eligibility_rules.sampled_seen_mask: All user-item events at or before source timestamp, including source item
eligibility_rules.negative_semantics: Unobserved comparison jobs, not proven negative preferences; no exclusion based on future outcomes
eligibility_rules.shared_inputs: Every comparator must load the identical materialized case order, candidate array and manifest hashes; no method-specific candidate generation
eligibility_rules.coverage_denominator: Number of cutoff-observed eligible catalog items, not maximum item ID plus one

ranking_rules.order: Descending finite score, then ascending item ID across the entire cutoff boundary
ranking_rules.sparse_similarity: Apply global deterministic top-k selection before storing each sparse row
ranking_rules.fusion: All eligible unseen sparse-support items plus top K eligible outside-support auxiliary items; normalize base on eligible unseen support
ranking_rules.gamma_zero: Use ascending item ID for zero-score outside-support ties; do not use auxiliary magnitude when its coefficient is zero
ranking_rules.sentinels: Missing recommendations are excluded from exposure and coverage; precision retains its K denominator
ranking_rules.implementation_gate: New comparison drivers must use protocol_primitives and materialized manifests, not the archived samplers or top-k routines

selection_and_comparators.backbone_reference: RP3Beta alpha=1 beta=0.3 topK=200 is a fixed reference, not a claim of an exhaustively tuned optimum
selection_and_comparators.validation_users: A single materialized sample of 30000 eligible full-catalog development users, seed 10, shared across all methods; unused development users are not independent confirmation
selection_and_comparators.budget_rule: Equal weight grids and validation users per family; the rate-shrinkage strength and recency half-life below are fixed before comparative scoring and are not selected on later outcomes

prior_definitions.interaction_popularity: log1p of all pre-cutoff interaction events per item, divided by eligible-catalog maximum
prior_definitions.successful_contact_count: log1p of pre-cutoff contact_chat and contact_phone_click_2 or 3 event counts, divided by eligible-catalog maximum; no maturity mechanism is claimed for this score
prior_definitions.smoothed_contact_rate: (successful contact events + 20 times global successful-contact event share) divided by (all interaction events + 20), then divided by eligible-catalog maximum
prior_definitions.interaction_recency: exp(-ln(2) times elapsed seconds since last pre-cutoff item event divided by 86400), then divided by eligible-catalog maximum
prior_definitions.fixed_parameter_limit: Shrinkage strength 20 interactions and recency half-life 24 hours are documented fixed reference choices; comparisons do not establish superiority to optimally tuned versions of these families

selection_and_comparators.p3ltr_scope: Published degree-recency component is an external-parameter reference, not full P3LTR or a locally optimally tuned architecture
selection_and_comparators.primary_selection: Maximum development NDCG@10 subject to coverage at least 95% of same-case RP3Beta; ties by Recall@10 then smaller weight; zero weight remains eligible
selection_and_comparators.accuracy_frontier: Show development trade-offs and apply development-selected operating points unchanged to later evaluation; never choose weights using later metrics
selection_and_comparators.neural_scope: No broad architectural superiority claim from unequal resource-constrained comparators

statistics.uncertainty: Paired user bootstrap, 5000 replicates, seed 20261020; report pointwise 95% intervals as pointwise rather than simultaneous
statistics.multiplicity: For the five primary differences also report Bonferroni simultaneous bootstrap intervals at 99% each, targeting a 95% family confidence level; bootstrap coverage remains approximate
statistics.secondary: Sampled metrics, auxiliary BIM controls, coverage, exposure, and subgroups are exploratory; label intervals accordingly
statistics.repeated_users: Do not treat repeated cases or folds from the same user as independent observations when pooling
statistics.selection_limit: Intervals are conditional on recorded settings and observed users; multiplicity adjustment does not remove research-selection bias from previously inspected outcomes
statistics.equivalence: Failure to exclude zero is not equivalence; no equivalence or noninferiority claim without a justified margin
statistics.operational_effect: No validated operational threshold exists; report absolute and relative effects without claiming practical benefit from statistical significance alone

exposure_and_efficiency.popularity_bands: Define using training-only item interaction counts and deterministic item-ID ties; save membership before later scoring
exposure_and_efficiency.report: Accuracy, catalog coverage, head/tail exposure, and tail-target quality together; disclose overlapping user subgroups
exposure_and_efficiency.efficiency: Record runtime, hardware, batch size, graph rebuild and serving costs separately; no deployment-efficiency superiority claim without matched measurements
